image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated on a wooden balcony within a church or concert hall. The organ features a Gothic-revival style wooden case with pointed arches and decorative finials. Multiple ranks of vertical metal pipes of varying heights are visible, arranged symmetrically. A crystal chandelier hangs in the foreground, partially obscuring the right side of the instrument. The lighting is warm and ambient.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic classification of the instrument as a pipe organ and distinguish it from other large musical structures.
To verify the spatial relationship between the foreground chandelier and the background organ, ensuring no geometric melting or depth inconsistencies.
To ensure individual pipes are distinct entities with sharp boundaries and do not merge into the wooden casing or each other.
To assess general image quality, checking for subtle texture anomalies or compression artifacts in the wood and metal surfaces.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junctions where the metal pipes meet the wooden casing. AI generators often struggle with these intersections, causing slight bleeding or warping. Also, verify that the chandelier's reflection and blur are physically consistent with its position relative to the organ.
